rows.definition: Bounded logical resident-slot replacement policy in modelloadplan, adapted from llama.cpp ClassLRU: eight frequency-class LRU lists retain exponentially decayed CRF across eviction and choose the oldest unselected candidate with largest age divided by two to its class. Plan serializes state changes using per-layer token clocks.
rows.distinction: This is host-side logical residency planning, not ExpertCacheTier physical weight placement, loader I/O, device synchronization or evidence that weights occupy a returned slot.

rows.definition: Maximum logical layer-times-expert entries accepted by NewExpertCacheLRFU: 1 shifted left by 20, checked using division before allocating arrays.
rows.distinction: This bounds policy metadata geometry, not the requested resident slot count, byte capacity, or frequency-class count.

rows.definition: Eight frequency buckets used by ExpertCacheLRFU to organize resident slots into separate LRU lists.
rows.distinction: The bucket count is not metadata entry capacity and does not encode physical weight-storage tiers.

rows.definition: Float32 value 128 used as the per-layer token-clock half-life when decaying ExpertCacheLRFU CRF with Exp2.
rows.distinction: This is a token-age decay constant, not wall-clock duration, class count or an eviction deadline.

rows.definition: Constructor refusal sentinel for nonpositive geometry, excessive logical entries or resident slots exceeding layer-times-expert entries.
rows.distinction: This rejects policy construction, unlike ErrExpertCacheLRFUInput which rejects an access to an existing policy.

rows.definition: Access refusal sentinel for a nil ExpertCacheLRFU, out-of-range layer or expert ID, or negative token increment.
rows.distinction: This is malformed access input, not valid selections exceeding resident slots or token-clock overflow.

rows.definition: Plan refusal sentinel when distinct selected experts exceed available logical resident slots, before policy state changes.
rows.distinction: This is selected-set cardinality overflow, not constructor metadata geometry or physical memory allocation failure.

rows.definition: Plan refusal sentinel when a nonnegative token increment would overflow the selected layer int64 clock.
rows.distinction: This protects logical token arithmetic, not a timeout, wall-clock fault or resident-capacity refusal.

rows.definition: Layer and Expert integer pair identifying one logical expert in the ExpertCacheLRFU policy and its fill or eviction observations.
rows.distinction: This identifies an expert, not a resident slot, physical pointer, payload digest or access-frequency score.

rows.definition: One logical cache-plan miss result: selected ExpertCacheKey, assigned slot and optional owned copy of the evicted expert key.
rows.distinction: This records simulated placement, not completed weight transfer; nil Evicted means an unused slot, not an unknown victim.

rows.definition: Plan result containing resident hit count, layer clock before and after the token increment, and ordered logical fill observations.
rows.distinction: This summarizes one policy transition rather than a single fill or proof of loader and device completion.

rows.definition: Owned scalar Inspect snapshot of an expert: resident slot/class, retained CRF, current decayed CRF, last-use token and layer clock.
rows.distinction: This is an observation without mutation, not a Plan result; class remains the last-use resident bucket and CRF persists after eviction.

rows.definition: Constructor validating layer, expert and slot geometry and allocating the bounded logical ClassLRU policy with empty slots and zero layer clocks.
rows.distinction: This initializes policy metadata only, not weight allocation, cache warm-start or a per-token Plan transition.

rows.definition: Internal bucket calculation that converts log2 of post-use CRF to float32 before integer truncation and caps the result at the last of eight classes.
rows.distinction: This computes frequency class, not victim age score or live class recomputation during Inspect; float32 rounding follows donor bucket boundaries.

rows.definition: One ExpertCacheLRFU.Plan transition result in modelloadplan: counts logical hits, records the selected layer token-clock interval, and lists ordered fill and eviction decisions.
rows.distinction: This is the returned description of one policy transition, not a scheduler execution plan or proof that loader I/O succeeded; the cache-family entry describes its logical residency observations.

rows.definition: NewExpertCacheLRFU constructor parameter fixing the number of logical resident expert slots across the policy layers; it must be positive and no greater than layers times experts.
rows.distinction: This is simulated expert-residency capacity, not scheduler running-session slots, a byte budget, or device allocation; Plan rejects selections whose distinct experts exceed it.
